name: Attached 45-Min Full Body Microformer
subtitle: Slow Lagree-tempo full-body class — core, lunges, inner thighs, spider kicks, cable rows, arms, and obliques.

segments.title: Welcome & Setup
segments.position: Seated on the front platform, toes under the strap on the carriage.
segments.details: Welcome the class, set one black spring in front, and prep the opening core block.
cues: Set the tone — slow and controlled today

segments.title: Seated Core Lean Back to Leg Extension
segments.position: Seated on front platform, toes under strap on carriage, hands behind the ears.
segments.details: Lean back and extend the legs together on a five-count tempo.
corrections: Do not arch the lower back
segments.transitionNote: Halfway, hold and twist

segments.title: Seated Core Twist
segments.details: Hold halfway; twist right and left from the ribs.
segments.transitionNote: Pulse center next

segments.title: Seated Core Pulses
segments.details: Pulse the upper body up/down in center, small controlled range.

segments.title: Reverse Wheelbarrow
segments.position: Knees on front platform, straight arms on carriage (kneeling plank).
segments.details: Shoulders, hips, and knees in one line; tailbone toward the belly. Move the carriage away with the arms, body still.

segments.title: Reverse Wheelbarrow Hold
segments.details: Hold the furthest controlled point.

segments.title: Reverse Wheelbarrow (Return)
segments.details: Return to the full controlled range.

segments.title: Plank to Pike
segments.position: Toes on the front platform where the knees were; full plank.
segments.details: Lift the hips slowly to the ceiling and lower to plank. Keep the heels high and core tight.
segments.transitionNote: Set up Leg Block 1 — stay on 1 black spring

segments.title: Runner's Lunge
segments.position: Facing back, right (front) leg on carriage, back foot on front platform, feet & knees straight ahead.
segments.details: Bend the front leg and push the carriage away, leaning slightly forward; back heel high; slow return.
cues: Front knee tracks over the ankle
corrections: Front knee does not pass the toes
variations: Back foot to the floor for stability

segments.title: Static Hold Down / Forward Lean
segments.details: Hold low; upper body leans toward the front leg; spine long, core engaged.
variations: Arms optional — reach forward to deepen

segments.title: Lunge Full Range
segments.details: Slow five-count up and down through the full lunge range.
variations: Arms by the ears or to the ceiling for extra load

segments.title: Moonwalker
segments.details: Stay low. Pull the carriage back from the back leg; at 90/90 press the back leg long again.
cues: Front leg stays still — only the back leg moves

segments.title: 90/90 Pulses
segments.details: Stay low; small, slow, controlled pulses.

segments.title: Switch Sides
segments.details: Turn around and set up the lunge on the other side.
segments.transitionNote: Turn around and set up the lunge on the other side.

segments.title: Runner's Lunge
segments.position: Facing back, left (front) leg on carriage, back foot on front platform, feet & knees straight ahead.
segments.details: Bend the front leg and push the carriage away, leaning slightly forward; back heel high; slow return.
cues: Front knee tracks over the ankle
corrections: Front knee does not pass the toes
variations: Back foot to the floor for stability

segments.title: Static Hold Down / Forward Lean
segments.details: Hold low; upper body leans toward the front leg; spine long, core engaged.
variations: Arms optional — reach forward to deepen

segments.title: Lunge Full Range
segments.details: Slow five-count up and down through the full lunge range.
variations: Arms by the ears or to the ceiling for extra load

segments.title: Moonwalker
segments.details: Stay low. Pull the carriage back from the back leg; at 90/90 press the back leg long again.
cues: Front leg stays still — only the back leg moves

segments.title: 90/90 Pulses
segments.details: Stay low; small, slow, controlled pulses.

segments.title: Set Up Inner Thighs
segments.details: Face the side wall, one foot on carriage, one on the front platform, weight even.
segments.transitionNote: Face the side wall, one foot on carriage, one on the front platform, weight even.

segments.title: Gliding Open
segments.position: Facing side wall, one foot on carriage, other on front platform, weight even.
segments.details: Slowly open the legs and move the carriage away; slowly bring them together.

segments.title: Halfway Open Squat
segments.details: Hold the carriage halfway open; squat up/down with no carriage movement.

segments.title: X-Squat
segments.details: Combine the squat and the gliding open; raise the arms while gliding, return slowly.
corrections: Never let the carriage hit the front

segments.title: Squat Pulses
segments.details: Stay low; small, slow pulses.
segments.transitionNote: Spring change to 1 white + 1 grey

segments.title: Change Springs · 1 White + 1 Grey
segments.details: Change to 1 white + 1 grey and set up the spider kick, kneeling on the carriage.
segments.transitionNote: Change to 1 white + 1 grey and set up the spider kick, kneeling on the carriage.

segments.title: Spider Kick
segments.position: Facing side, right knee on carriage, hands on carriage, opposite foot against the front platform edge.
segments.details: Align the working knee and the bracing foot; press the carriage out and bring it in. Working leg stops at 90°.

segments.title: Hold Halfway
segments.details: Hold at the most challenging point; breathe and stay strong.
cues: Find your sticking point and hold

segments.title: Spider Kick (Full Range)
segments.details: Return to the full controlled range of the kick.
cues: Slow and even on the return

segments.title: Spider Pulses
segments.details: Move to halfway and pulse; small, slow, controlled.

segments.title: Switch Sides
segments.details: Repeat the spider kick on the other side.
segments.transitionNote: Repeat the spider kick on the other side.

segments.title: Spider Kick
segments.position: Facing side, left knee on carriage, hands on carriage, opposite foot against the front platform edge.
segments.details: Align the working knee and the bracing foot; press the carriage out and bring it in. Working leg stops at 90°.

segments.title: Hold Halfway
segments.details: Hold at the most challenging point; breathe and stay strong.
cues: Find your sticking point and hold

segments.title: Spider Kick (Full Range)
segments.details: Return to the full controlled range of the kick.
cues: Slow and even on the return

segments.title: Spider Pulses
segments.details: Move to halfway and pulse; small, slow, controlled.

segments.title: Add Cables · 1 Black + 1 White
segments.details: Attach the arm cables, move to the back of the machine, change to 1 black + 1 white.
segments.transitionNote: Attach the arm cables, move to the back of the machine, change to 1 black + 1 white.

segments.title: 90/90 Squat + Low Row
segments.position: Arm cables attached, at back of machine. Facing front, right (front) leg on back platform, other foot on the floor behind.
segments.details: Lower to 90/90 (front & back legs at right angles); as you lower, pull the arms into a low row; rise and extend the arms.
cues: Engage the lats on the row
corrections: Back knee stays under the hips

segments.title: Static 90/90 Hold + Arms Row
segments.details: Hold the legs at 90/90 while the arms row.
cues: Hold the line of the legs perfectly still

segments.title: 90/90 Full Range with Arms
segments.details: Five-count rise and lower, arms rowing with the legs.

segments.title: Static 90/90 Legs & Arms
segments.details: Hold 90/90 in the row/arms position.

segments.title: 90/90 Leg Pulses
segments.details: Arms static; legs pulse.

segments.title: Switch Sides
segments.details: Repeat the 90/90 squat + low row on the other side.
segments.transitionNote: Repeat the 90/90 squat + low row on the other side.

segments.title: 90/90 Squat + Low Row
segments.position: Arm cables attached, at back of machine. Facing front, left (front) leg on back platform, other foot on the floor behind.
segments.details: Lower to 90/90 (front & back legs at right angles); as you lower, pull the arms into a low row; rise and extend the arms.
cues: Engage the lats on the row
corrections: Back knee stays under the hips

segments.title: Static 90/90 Hold + Arms Row
segments.details: Hold the legs at 90/90 while the arms row.
cues: Hold the line of the legs perfectly still

segments.title: 90/90 Full Range with Arms
segments.details: Five-count rise and lower, arms rowing with the legs.

segments.title: Static 90/90 Legs & Arms
segments.details: Hold 90/90 in the row/arms position.

segments.title: 90/90 Leg Pulses
segments.details: Arms static; legs pulse.

segments.title: Detach Cables · 1 Black
segments.details: Detach the cables and change to 1 black. Kneel at the back of the machine facing the carriage; grab the handles.
segments.transitionNote: Detach the cables and change to 1 black. Kneel at the back of the machine facing the carriage; grab the handles.

segments.title: Sexy Back / Triceps Extension
segments.position: Kneeling at back of machine facing carriage, grab the handles, hinge forward with a flat back and open chest.
segments.details: Extend the forearms back and bend; elbows lifted in line with the shoulders, shoulder blades together.

segments.title: Arms Back Pulses
segments.details: Extend the arms and pulse the forearms; small, slow, controlled — the carriage moves.

segments.title: Bicep Curls
segments.position: Low kneeling, elbows lifted so the upper arms are parallel to the floor, palms up.
segments.details: Curl the forearms but do not go over 90°, then slowly extend.

segments.title: Bicep Pulses
segments.details: Arms and elbows high; pulse centimeter by centimeter.

segments.title: Bicep Hold
segments.details: Hold at 90°; do not drop the elbows. Last arm variation.
segments.transitionNote: Set up obliques — knees on front platform, elbows on carriage

segments.title: Twisted Saw
segments.position: Knees on front platform, elbows on carriage, knee plank, hips twisted so the obliques face down.
segments.details: Rotate the hips toward the right so more weight is on that knee. Push the carriage away with the arms, maintaining the hip twist.
cues: Maintain the twist the whole rep

segments.title: Furthest Point Pulses
segments.details: Find the furthest point and pulse/hold centimeter by centimeter.

segments.title: Side Plank Thread the Needle
segments.position: Side plank, right elbow under the shoulder.
segments.details: Reach the top arm under the body and twist, then open to the ceiling.
cues: Lift the hips on the open
variations: Straighten the legs for more challenge

segments.title: Switch Sides
segments.details: Side plank first, then the saw with the hips twisted on the other side.
segments.transitionNote: Side plank first, then the saw with the hips twisted on the other side.

segments.title: Twisted Saw
segments.position: Knees on front platform, elbows on carriage, knee plank, hips twisted so the obliques face down.
segments.details: Rotate the hips toward the left so more weight is on that knee. Push the carriage away with the arms, maintaining the hip twist.
cues: Maintain the twist the whole rep

segments.title: Furthest Point Pulses
segments.details: Find the furthest point and pulse/hold centimeter by centimeter.

segments.title: Side Plank Thread the Needle
segments.position: Side plank, left elbow under the shoulder.
segments.details: Reach the top arm under the body and twist, then open to the ceiling.
cues: Lift the hips on the open
variations: Straighten the legs for more challenge

segments.title: Cool Down & Breath
segments.position: Seated or kneeling, carriage still.
segments.details: Slow stretches and breath work. Thank the class and let the heart rate settle.
cues: Roll the shoulders down and back

name: Beginner 35-Min Foundations
subtitle: An approachable on-ramp with longer setups, shorter holds, and clear cues. Original template informed by common microformer structure.

segments.title: Welcome & Breathing
segments.details: Introduce the springs and the carriage; a few breaths to center.

segments.title: High Plank Hold
segments.position: Hands on the front platform, toes on the carriage.
segments.details: Hold a steady high plank, pushing back through the heels.
variations: Drop one foot to the floor to modify

segments.title: Plank to Pike (Slow)
segments.details: Lift the hips toward the ceiling and lower slowly.

segments.title: Seated Core Lean Back
segments.position: Seated on the front platform, toes under the strap.
segments.details: Lean back and extend the legs on a slow count.

segments.title: Seated Core Twist
segments.details: Hold halfway and rotate gently from the ribs.

segments.title: Set Up Lunges
segments.details: Face the back; front foot on carriage, back foot on the platform.
segments.transitionNote: Face the back; front foot on carriage, back foot on the platform.

segments.title: Runner's Lunge — Right
segments.details: Bend the front leg and press the carriage away; slow return.

segments.title: Runner's Lunge — Left
segments.details: Repeat on the other side, matching the tempo.

segments.title: Set Up Inner Thighs
segments.details: Face the side; one foot on carriage, one on platform, weight even.
segments.transitionNote: Face the side; one foot on carriage, one on platform, weight even.

segments.title: Gliding Open
segments.details: Open the legs slowly and bring them back together.

segments.title: Halfway Squat Hold
segments.details: Hold halfway open and squat with a small range.

segments.title: Set Up Kneeling Arms
segments.details: Kneel at the back, grab the handles, flat back.
segments.transitionNote: Kneel at the back, grab the handles, flat back.

segments.title: Triceps Extension
segments.details: Extend the forearms back and bend, elbows lifted.

segments.title: Bicep Curls
segments.details: Curl to 90° and extend slowly.

segments.title: Set Up Obliques
segments.details: Knees on platform, elbows on carriage, hips twisted.
segments.transitionNote: Knees on platform, elbows on carriage, hips twisted.

segments.title: Twisted Saw — Right
segments.details: Press the carriage away while holding the hip twist.

segments.title: Twisted Saw — Left
segments.details: Repeat on the other side.

segments.title: Cool Down Stretch
segments.details: Gentle stretches and breathing to finish.

name: 45-Min Strength & Obliques
subtitle: Full body with extra plank, oblique, and inner-thigh emphasis. Original template; segments kept under ~2 min per side.

segments.title: Welcome & Core Prep
segments.details: Set one black spring and warm up the core with a few slow leans.

segments.title: High Plank Hold
segments.position: Hands on platform, toes on carriage.
segments.details: Steady plank, pushing back through the heels.

segments.title: Reverse Wheelbarrow
segments.position: Kneeling plank, straight arms on carriage.
segments.details: Press the carriage away with the arms; body still.

segments.title: Plank to Pike
segments.details: Lift the hips up and lower with control.

segments.title: Seated Core Leg Extension
segments.position: Seated, toes under strap.
segments.details: Lean back, extend the legs, slow tempo.

segments.title: Seated Core Pulses
segments.details: Small controlled pulses in center.

segments.title: Twisted Saw
segments.position: Knees on platform, elbows on carriage, hips twisted.
segments.details: Press the carriage away, maintaining a strong hip twist.

segments.title: Furthest-Point Pulses
segments.details: Hold the deepest point and pulse small.

segments.title: Side Plank Thread the Needle
segments.details: Thread the top arm under and open to the ceiling.

segments.title: Switch Sides
segments.details: Repeat the oblique series on the other side.
segments.transitionNote: Repeat the oblique series on the other side.

segments.title: Twisted Saw
segments.position: Knees on platform, elbows on carriage, hips twisted.
segments.details: Press the carriage away, maintaining a strong hip twist.

segments.title: Furthest-Point Pulses
segments.details: Hold the deepest point and pulse small.

segments.title: Side Plank Thread the Needle
segments.details: Thread the top arm under and open to the ceiling.

segments.title: Set Up Lunges
segments.details: Face the back for a strong lunge block.
segments.transitionNote: Face the back for a strong lunge block.

segments.title: Runner's Lunge — Right
segments.details: Press the carriage away and return slowly.

segments.title: Moonwalker — Right
segments.details: Stay low; only the back leg moves.

segments.title: Runner's Lunge — Left
segments.details: Repeat the lunge on the other side.

segments.title: Moonwalker — Left
segments.details: Repeat the moonwalker on the other side.

segments.title: Set Up Inner Thighs · Light
segments.details: Face the side, weight even on both feet.
segments.transitionNote: Face the side, weight even on both feet.

segments.title: Gliding Open
segments.details: Open and close the legs slowly.

segments.title: X-Squat
segments.details: Combine the squat with the glide; arms rise as you open.
corrections: Never let the carriage slam the front

segments.title: Squat Pulses
segments.details: Low pulses, small and slow.

segments.title: Set Up Arms · 1 Black
segments.details: Kneel at the back, grab the handles.
segments.transitionNote: Kneel at the back, grab the handles.

segments.title: Triceps Extension
segments.details: Extend back and bend, elbows lifted.

segments.title: Bicep Curls
segments.details: Curl to 90° and extend slowly.

segments.title: Bicep Hold
segments.details: Hold at 90° to finish the arms.

segments.title: Cool Down & Breath
segments.details: Stretch and breathe to close the class.

name: 25-Min Express Lower Body
subtitle: A quick, legs-forward session: lunges, moonwalker, spider kick, glider, and a short core finisher. Original express template.

segments.title: Quick Setup
segments.details: One black spring; brief warm-up breaths and a few bodyweight squats.
cues: We move fast but stay controlled

segments.title: Runner's Lunge — Right
segments.position: Facing back, right foot on carriage, back foot on platform.
segments.details: Press the carriage away and return on a slow count.

segments.title: Moonwalker — Right
segments.details: Stay low; pull from the back leg to 90/90 and press long.

segments.title: Runner's Lunge — Left
segments.details: Repeat the lunge on the left.

segments.title: Moonwalker — Left
segments.details: Repeat the moonwalker on the left.

segments.title: Change Springs · 1 White + 1 Grey
segments.details: Change to 1 white + 1 grey and kneel on the carriage for the spider kick.
segments.transitionNote: Change to 1 white + 1 grey and kneel on the carriage for the spider kick.

segments.title: Spider Kick — Right
segments.details: Press the carriage out and in; working leg stops at 90°.

segments.title: Spider Pulses — Right
segments.details: Halfway pulses, small and slow.

segments.title: Spider Kick — Left
segments.details: Repeat the spider kick on the left.

segments.title: Spider Pulses — Left
segments.details: Repeat the pulses on the left.

segments.title: Set Up Inner Thighs · Light
segments.details: Face the side, weight even.
segments.transitionNote: Face the side, weight even.

segments.title: Gliding Open
segments.details: Open and close the legs slowly.

segments.title: Halfway Open Squat
segments.details: Hold halfway open and squat with a small range.

segments.title: Core Finisher · 1 Black
segments.details: Quick spring change to 1 black; seated core to finish.
segments.transitionNote: Quick spring change to 1 black; seated core to finish.

segments.title: Seated Core Leg Extension
segments.position: Seated, toes under the strap.
segments.details: Lean back and extend the legs; slow and strong.

segments.title: Seated Core Pulses
segments.details: Small controlled pulses to finish.

segments.title: Cool Down
segments.details: A short stretch and a few breaths.
